title: Slow-Cooked {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C). Pat the {p} dry and let it come toward room temperature while the oven heats.
Sear the {p} in a heavy ovenproof pot with a little oil, 2 to 3 minutes per side, until evenly browned. Season with salt and the {spice}.
Scatter the {v} and the cut-up {s} around the {p} and pour in the {sauce}. Cover tightly.
Bake about 2 hours, until fork-tender (about 195°F / 91°C to 205°F / 96°C inside). It is safe once {doneness}, and a roast is well past that by then.
Rest the {p} 15 minutes under foil, slice thinly, and serve with the vegetables and the pan juices.
tip: Trim the visible fat and fill the pot with vegetables. The pan juices become a light gravy.
